summary: Coverage is severely limited: only one dated source was retrieved before the search-tool limit was hit. US stocks were mixed on Nov 18, 2026: the S&P 500 fell 0.2%, its fifth straight losing session, while the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.4% to snap a four-day skid. Nvidia shares fell after an earnings report the source described as strong, and the headline reported a 560-point Dow drop. Energy was the weakest S&P 500 sector (-3.5%), and health care fell about 2% as UnitedHealth (-10%) and Humana (-13%) dropped on regulatory concerns. Nothing was retrieved for FX/central banks, crypto, oil fundamentals, gold, non-US indices, other megacaps or the economic calendar.
